description_full: Bellevue Gold Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, development, mining, and processing of gold properties in Australia. It primarily holds interest in the Bellevue gold project located to north-west of Leinster in the Goldfields region of Western Australia. The company was formerly known as Draig Resources Limited and changed its name to Bellevue Gold Limited in July 2018. Bellevue Gold Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in West Perth, Australia.

financial_summary: Bellevue Gold, Ltd. is a small-cap basic materials business with a $1.4B market cap on $396M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +41% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are contracting by -10.5pp, the first warning that competitive pressure is eroding the franchise.
Returns on capital run at 5% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 29%.
The business throws off $53M in free cash flow — roughly 13 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 4.2× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and interest coverage runs at 3.5×.
Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 3.2% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.4× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
